hypotheses.name: Signed TRRUST motif x module-structure robustness
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44 and source/target-disjoint splits at layer 11; graph community label propagation on kNN graph plus true signed TRRUST motif-consistency interactions over H70; nulls: community label shuffle, TRRUST-sign shuffle within TF-degree bins, label permutation.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.09885 (18 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=3/6
hypotheses.next_action: Run higher-null-budget confirmation and dual-axis-disjoint robustness before promotion to core claim.

hypotheses.name: Disagreement-conditioned cross-model transfer
hypotheses.method: Seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits at layer 11; aligned Geneformer role signatures to scGPT and evaluated disagreement-quantile-gated transfer model vs ungated baseline; nulls: disagreement-bin permutation within edge strata, random gene mapping, label permutation.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.00060 (6 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=1/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this endpoint and only revisit cross-model transfer with a materially different objective.
hypotheses.retirement_reason: Near-zero utility and null-gap support in only 1/6 domain-splits after major method change.

hypotheses.name: Geodesic-path curvature drift descriptors
hypotheses.method: Seed42 across immune/lung/external_lung with source/target-disjoint splits and layers {7,11}; Forman-curvature path descriptors on weighted kNN geodesics added to H70; nulls: distance-bin feature shuffle, degree-bin feature shuffle, label permutation.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.03854 (12 rows); positive mean null-gap domain-splits=3/6
hypotheses.next_action: Increase null resolution and test interaction-only curvature terms before promotion.
